lines.text: Darius appoints 120 satraps and three administrators, and plans to set Daniel over the whole kingdom.
The officials ask for a decree that for thirty days no one may petition any god or man except Darius, and he signs.
Daniel learns the decree is signed and still kneels three times a day, with windows open toward Egypt.
Daniel is thrown into the den, a stone is sealed over it, and the king fasts all night.
Daniel tells the king that God sent a servant to shut the lions' mouths, and he is lifted out unharmed.
